verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Recruitee has 'Applicant management & pipeline' and lets recruiters 'create and manage your job openings, hiring pipelines, and application forms,' supporting the general pipeline-management capability, but nothing describes custom per-job stages, drag-to-move candidate UI, or bulk actions across the pipeline. missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom stage configuration, drag-and-drop candidate movement, and bulk-action tooling across candidates/stages.
